title: Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Appointment of Graduates of National Teachers Colleges Who Have Not Been Appointed as Teachers, Etc.
title_original: 국립사범대학 졸업자 중 교원미임용자 임용 등에 관한 특별법 시행령
full_text:
Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Appointment of Graduates of National Teachers Colleges Who Have Not Been Appointed as Teachers, Etc.

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on the Appointment of Graduates of National Teachers Colleges Who Have Not Been Appointed as Teachers, Etc. and matters necessary for its implementation.

Article 2 (Public Notice of Plans for Operating Minor Programs)
Where the Minister of Education establishes a minor program under Article 6 of the Special Act on the Appointment of Graduates of National Teachers Colleges Who Have Not Been Appointed as Teachers, Etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") for registered unappointed persons under Article 3 (2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "registered unappointed persons"), the Minister shall publicly announce a plan for operating the minor program, including the following matters, no later than one month before the program begins: <Amended on February 29, 2008; March 23, 2013>
1. Subjects in which minor programs are offered;
2. Educational institutions at which minor programs are to be completed;
3. The application period and method for minor programs;
4. Other matters determined and publicly notified by the Minister of Education.

Article 3 (Establishment of Minor Programs, Etc.)
(1) Where the Minister of Education intends to establish minor programs pursuant to Article 6 of the Act, the Minister shall determine the subjects to be endorsed as minors in consideration of the planned number of teachers to be recruited for each endorsed subject by each Special Metropolitan City, Metropolitan City, and Do office of education, the status of subjects indicated on the teaching certificates of registered unappointed persons, and other relevant matters. <Amended on February 29, 2008; March 23, 2013>
(2) The head of an educational institution for completion of a minor program under Article 6 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "minor program educational institution") shall publicly announce in advance, before operating the minor program, the number of persons to be recruited for each endorsed subject, the selection method, tuition fees, the period of education, evaluation methods, completion requirements, and other relevant matters.
(3) Where fewer than 15 persons register for an endorsed subject, the head of a minor program educational institution may recruit additional persons wishing to complete that subject within the period prescribed by the Minister of Education. <Amended on February 29, 2008; March 23, 2013>
(4) Where fewer than 15 persons register despite additional recruitment under paragraph (3), the head of a minor program educational institution may decide not to establish the minor program for that endorsed subject. In such cases, any tuition fees collected in advance shall be refunded in full.

Article 4 (Applications for Completion of Minor Programs, Etc.)
(1) A registered unappointed person wishing to complete a minor program shall apply to the superintendent of education of the Special Metropolitan City, Metropolitan City, or Do who manages the list of candidates for appointment on which the registered unappointed person was entered (hereinafter referred to as the "appointing authority"). In such cases, the registered unappointed person may apply to the appointing authority through the head of the minor program educational institution offering the minor program that the person wishes to complete.
(2) An appointing authority receiving an application for completion of a minor program under paragraph (1) shall immediately notify the head of the minor program educational institution of the details of the application: Provided, That this shall not apply where a registered unappointed person applies through the head of the minor program educational institution pursuant to the latter part of paragraph (1).

Article 5 (Completion of Minor Programs, Etc.)
(1) Completion of a minor program shall be recognized where the person scores at least 60 points out of a maximum of 100 points in each subject.
(2) Evaluation criteria for each subject of a minor program shall be determined by the head of the relevant minor program educational institution.
(3) Where a person who has failed to complete a minor program wishes to retake that program, the head of the minor program educational institution may recognize credits obtained in the uncompleted minor program as credits obtained in the minor program that the person wishes to retake.
(4) A person taking a minor program shall comply with the academic regulations of the relevant minor program educational institution.
(5) The head of a minor program educational institution shall notify the appointing authority of the completion results within 10 days after the minor program ends.
(6) The appointing authority shall endorse the minor subject for a registered unappointed person who has completed the minor program.

Article 6 (Transfer Admission to Universities of Education)
(1) Where the head of a university of education under Article 7 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "university of education") intends to admit registered unappointed persons as transfer students, the head shall conduct a special transfer admission process for registered unappointed persons within the annual number of persons specified under Article 7 (3) of the Act.
(2) The special transfer admission process under paragraph (1) shall be conducted by such methods as consideration of university academic records, essay examinations, and interviews, and other necessary matters shall be prescribed in the academic regulations by the head of the relevant university of education.
(3) Where the number of registered unappointed persons applying through the special transfer admission process falls short of the number of places available, the head of the university of education may fill the unfilled places with applicants for general transfer admission.

Article 7 (Formulation and Public Notice of Special Training Plans)
Where an appointing authority intends to conduct special training under Article 8 (1) of the Act, the appointing authority shall formulate and publicly announce in advance a special training plan that includes the following matters:
1. The period and methods of special training;
2. The number of persons to receive special training and the method of their selection;
3. The contents of special training;
4. Other matters that the appointing authority deems necessary in connection with the conduct of special training.

Article 8 (Methods of Special Training, Etc.)
(1) An appointing authority shall conduct special training at a training institution affiliated with the appointing authority, or entrust the conduct of special training to another training institution or educational institution not affiliated with the appointing authority, a specified institution under Article 5 of the Regulations on Training of Teachers, Etc., or another such institution.
(2) Special training under paragraph (1) shall be conducted within three years after the appointing authority recruits a registered unappointed person.
(3) Articles 9 and 10 of the Regulations on Training of Teachers, Etc. shall apply mutatis mutandis to special training. In such cases, "head of the training institute", "training results", and "head of the affiliated institution" shall each be construed as "head of the institution conducting special training", "special training results", and "appointing authority", respectively.

Article 9 (Notification of Transfer Applicants to Universities of Education, Etc.)
The head of a university of education shall notify each appointing authority of the list of registered unappointed persons who have applied through the university's special transfer admission process pursuant to Article 6, and each appointing authority shall notify the head of each university of education of the list of persons who have taken the secondary school teacher recruitment examination under Article 4 of the Act.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 19083, October 13, 2005>

(1) (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

(2) (Transitional Measures for Persons Admitted by Transfer to Universities of Education) Any person who has been admitted by transfer to a university of education under the former provisions at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed to have been admitted by transfer to a university of education under the provisions of this Decree.

(3) (Relationship to Other Statutes and Regulations) Where, at the time this Decree enters into force, other statutes or regulations cite the former Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Appointment of Graduates of National Teachers Colleges Who Have Not Been Appointed as Teachers, Etc. or any of its provisions, and this Decree contains corresponding provisions, such citations shall be deemed to be citations of this Decree or the corresponding provisions of this Decree in lieu of the former provisions.
